name: Etapp 7: First Camp Hökensås - Fagerhult
from: First Camp Hökensås / Hökensås Semesterby / stage-6 boundary
to: Fagerhult trailhead via Gagnån / stage-8 junction
description: First Camp Hökensås / Hökensås Semesterby / stage-6 boundary to Fagerhult trailhead via Gagnån / stage-8 junction. Candidate import from normalized research; verify current notices before publication.
waterSources: First Camp Hökensås service-house water: PDF says drinking water can be taken at the service house about 50 m west of reception. Use as campsite amenity unless exact tap coordinate is needed.
notes: Official Västsverige/Skaraborg sources report 17 km. Naturkartan VGR lists 15.2 km, Smålandsleden/Naturkartan lists 15.6 km, official mainline computes 15.219 km, and mainline plus Fagerhult access computes about 16.105 km.
Continuous stage-8 handoff is at Gagnån/Fagerhult junction, while the named endpoint Fagerhult is reached by a separate 0.886 km access connector.
Current official Västsverige order is First Camp Hökensås -> Fagerhult. Smålandsleden/Naturkartan title and GPX are Fagerhult -> Hökensås and stored reverse.
Current sources use First Camp Hökensås; older sources use Semesterbyn or Hökensås Semesterby.
Some tourism/older wording says reserve or national park, but Länsstyrelsen legal/current wording is naturvårdsområde.
Hållsdammsbäcken is mapped as shelter/fireplace, while Gagnån NR near Fagerhult has no-fire/no-tenting rules.

facilities.name: First Camp Hökensås-Tidaholm
facilities.description: Official stage start and year-round campground/cottage area with reception, restaurant/cafe, mini grocery, cabins, camping, parking, service houses, toilets, showers, laundry, waste sorting and drinking water from service house. Commercial service. Restaurant/shop hours vary by season; campsite open year-round.

facilities.name: Hökensås Camping Restaurant / service shop
facilities.description: Restaurant/cafe and service shop at First Camp, with basic groceries, bread, picnic/grill items and snacks. Verify opening hours before runtime display.

facilities.name: Hökensås Sportfiske
facilities.description: Fishing center beside First Camp; permits, equipment, lake information and boat keys. Fishing requires permits. Local conduct rules around fishing facilities can be stricter than legal baseline.

facilities.name: Ibbesjön shelter cluster
facilities.description: Official stage-7 shelter just beyond First Camp with table group, fireplace/grill, dry toilet/TC, parking, jetties and fishing context. Keep exact toilet and parking subfacility coordinates pending. Do not import lake water as potable.
facilities.routeProximity: about 100-120 m from mainline via 0.138 km official spur

facilities.name: Store Öjasjön grill/rest areas
facilities.description: Rest/fireplace/picnic/fishing context. PDF lists parking, table groups, grill and fishing; Tidaholm lists two barbecue spots with seating. Parking/fishing should be access/context metadata. South/parking-area grill coordinate also found at 58.06114,14.07690.
facilities.routeProximity: about 15-86 m; official grill spur about 22 m

facilities.name: Sydvattnet rest areas
facilities.description: Two barbecue/rest spots with seating. PDF lists parking, table groups, grill and fishing. Hökensås Sportfiske confirms grill at boat mooring and boat rental via fishing shop. Parking/fishing should be access/context metadata. South coordinate also found at 58.04825,14.06968.
facilities.routeProximity: about 22-59 m; official rest spur about 53 m

facilities.name: Hållsdammsbäcken shelter cluster
facilities.description: Official shelter cluster with fireplace and dry toilet/TC. OSM adds toilet, waste basket and information point. OSM shelter note says roof is leaking; verify before high-confidence user display. Overlay against Gagnån NR before importing fire/camping metadata.
facilities.routeProximity: about 4-43 m; official spur about 27 m

facilities.name: Fagerhult stage endpoint / access trailhead
facilities.description: Named Fagerhult endpoint reached by about 0.886-0.9 km official access route from Gagnån/stage-8 junction. PDF says parking at trail start in Fagerhult. Do not confuse with the Gagnån/stage-8 continuity junction.

facilities.name: Fagerhult bus/access point
facilities.description: Endpoint public-transport access. PDF warns buses stop at different stops depending on direction. Verify live planner stop/direction before runtime display.
